main_measure.name: mean excess 18-bar return of bets (return minus coin's normal 18-bar drift), before costs
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passing; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 30 independent cases

supporting_check.name: mean excess return of cases above the median signal forecast minus those at or below it

decided_by: The t of the mean excess return lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: A case is the first long bet (forecast rise of at least 2 points from its lowest positive level since the last bet, from 0 after flat) in each 18-bar grid cell counted from each window's first row, with its 18-bar return needing to end inside the window; the median split puts cases with forecast strictly above the median in the upper half and those at or below it in the lower half.
